exposure: Postoperative patient-controlled epidural analgesia (PCEA) with ropivacaine
Postoperative PCEA with ropivacaine combined with sufentanil
cohort: The study included 120 women who had recently undergone a cesarean section.
finding: PCEA with ropivacaine combined with sufentanil significantly decreased VAS scores, pain neurotransmitters, inflammatory factors, and stress hormones compared to ropivacaine alone after cesarean section.
